snippet.title: AFK GF - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Heya everyone, I just wanted to say I've developed my second game. Written, coded, composed, and drawn all by me, this one is very focused on the dystopic nature of the modern internet. I like making visual novels, and I hope it means something to someone.

Steam Link to the game -
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664630/AFK_GF/
